name: Knight Errant
author: mattboy112
description: Your ship is a steed and you are its sworn knight. Chivalry, honor, and very formal flares.

lines.arm_on: We enter the king's peace. Blades sheathed, my liege.
lines.arm_off: We leave the king's peace. Draw steel.
lines.juris_ungoverned: Lawless lands. Keep thy guard up.
lines.kill_n: The {victim} falls! {n} foes bested this day.
lines.downed: You are wounded, sire! Call for aid!
lines.target_shields_down: Their shield is broken! Strike now!
lines.greeting: Your squire stands ready, my liege.
